import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Clear nginx cache
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("rm -rf /var/cache/nginx/* && nginx -s reload")
print("Cache cleared:", stdout.read().decode())
# Check if PM2 is running on right port now
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ss -tlnp | grep 8080")
print("\n8080:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
